analyst_notes: efrencapital.com describes a sector-agnostic VC fund formed with the Czech-Singapore Chamber of Commerce: Series A / late seed, first ticket up to EUR 1m, equity and convertibles, companies with at least one Czech co-founder. The 'Portfolio' section shows only partners' prior engagements as unnamed logos; no deal news found. ARES: datumVzniku 2024-04-30, czNace 46190, 00. Would qualify as vc once a dated investment is public.
